# BPM / Laws+ compatibility patch - common/interest_groups
# Generated by tools/build.py. Do not rename: the zzzzzzzzzz_ prefix keeps
# these files last in the ASCII order the game resolves conflicts by.

# ig_petty_bourgeoisie
REPLACE:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = {
	color = hsv{ 0.59 0.12 0.6 }
	texture = "gfx/interface/icons/ig_icons/petty_bourgeoisie.dds"
	layer = "revolution_dynamic_petty_bourgeoisie"
	index = 5

	ideologies = {
		ideology_dop_state_power
		ideology_sta_institutional_state
		# Vanilla
		ideology_meritocratic
		ideology_patriotic
	}
	
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_moderate
		ideology_traditionalist
		# ideology_positivist
		# ideology_jingoist_leader
		# ideology_protectionist
		# ideology_orleanist
		# ideology_bonapartist
		# ideology_legitimist
		# ideology_sovereignist_leader
		# ideology_liberal_leader
		# ideology_corporatist_leader
		ideology_authoritarian
		ideology_reformer
	}

	enable = {
		always = yes
	}	
	
	on_enable = {
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = {
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_urban_systematic_corruption
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_urban_well_oiled_machine
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_urban_election_interference
		}

		# India
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BIC ?= THIS
			}
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_civil_servants
			}
		}
	}
	on_disable = {}

	priority_cultures = { #Country scope
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:BIC ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:british = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				assamese avadhi baluchi bengali bihari gujarati kannada malayalam marathi oriya panjabi pathan rajput sindi tamil telegu hindustani bundeli pahari gondi bageli chhattisgarhi deccani
			}
		}
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:ZAN ?= this
				any_primary_culture = {
					cu:bedouin = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				swahili gujarati
			}
		}
	}

	on_character_ig_membership = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				culture = cu:gujarati
				owner = {
					c:ZAN ?= this
					any_primary_culture = {
						cu:bedouin = this
					}
				}
			}
			change_character_religion = rel:shiite
		}
	}
	
	pop_potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = BPM_VALID_POP_FOR_IG
			owner ?= {
				NOT = {
					is_country_type = decentralized
				}
			}
		}
	}	
	
	pop_weight = {
		value = 0
	
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				value = 50
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clerks }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = bureaucrats }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_BUREAUCRATS"
				value = 250
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = capitalists }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_CAPITALISTS"
				value = 50
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = officers }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
				value = 20
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = aristocrats
				owner = { country_has_state_religion = rel:confucian }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS_CON"
				value = 250
			}
		}			
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = aristocrats }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
				value = 50
			}
		}
				
		add = {
			desc = "MILD_DISCRIMINATION"
			if = {
				limit = {
					pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_3
					pop_acceptance <= acceptance_status_4
					bpm_pop_employment_is_rural = no
				}
				value = 100
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_meritocratic_bureaucracy	# laws+
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POLITICAL_MACHINES"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POLITICAL_MACHINES"
				value = 50
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
				}
				#OR = {
				#	is_pop_type = bureaucrats
				#	is_pop_type = clerks
				#}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					desc = "POP_INDIA_COLONIAL_RULE"
					value = 0.01 #0.25
				}
			}
			else = {
				multiply = {
					desc = "POP_INDIA_CIVIL_SERVICE"
					value = 0.3 #1.5
				}
			}
		}
		
		add = {
			desc = "POP_MILITARY_BUREAUCRACY"
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = bureaucrats
					owner = {
						c:ALK ?= this
						has_government_type = gov_chartered_company
					}
				}
				multiply = 0.25
			}
		}

		multiply = ig_attraction_to_interests_from_stability
	}
	
	monarch_weight = {
		owner.ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = {
			value = bpm_ig_monarch_weight
		}
	}

	agitator_weight = {
		owner.ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = {
			value = bpm_base_agitator_weight
		}
	}
	
	commander_weight = {
		owner.ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = {
			value = bpm_commander_weight
		}
	}

	executive_weight = {
		value = 0.2
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_cooperative_ownership
						has_law = law_type:law_command_economy
					}
				}
			}
			value = 5.0
		}
	}
	
	noble_chance = {
		value = 0.5
	}
	
	female_commander_chance = {	
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_commander_spawn_chance
	}
	
	female_politician_chance = {
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_character_spawn_chance
	}	

	female_agitator_chance = {
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_character_spawn_chance		
	}

	female_executive_chance = {
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_character_spawn_chance
	}
	
	# The chance that a commander belonging to this IG takes over leadership when it changes
	# scope:character is the most popular commander in the IG
	commander_leader_chance = {
		value = 0.25
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:character
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1
				add = scope:character.popularity
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# ig_devout
REPLACE:ig_devout = {
	color = hsv{ 0.47 0.1 0.5 }
	texture = "gfx/interface/icons/ig_icons/devout.dds"
	layer = "revolution_dynamic_devout"
	index = 1
	
	ideologies = {
		ideology_rel_radical_moralist
		ideology_wel_religious_welfare
		ideology_fem_moderate_patriarchal
		# Vanilla
		ideology_pious
		ideology_moralist
		ideology_patriarchal
	}

	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_moderate
		ideology_traditionalist
		# ideology_reformer
		# ideology_land_reformer
		# ideology_legitimist
		# ideology_authoritarian
		ideology_theocrat
	}
	
	enable = {
		always = yes
	}
	
	on_enable = {
		ig:ig_devout = {
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_rural_systematic_corruption
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_rural_well_oiled_machine
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_rural_systematic_opposition
		}
		### Specific

		# Buddhist Monks (Japan)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:mahayana
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_buddhist_monks
				bpm_ig_make_buddhist_moralist = yes
			}
		}
		# Shinto Monks (Japan)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:shinto
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_shinto_monks
				bpm_ig_make_shinto_moralist = yes
			}
		}
		# Christian Missionaries (Hawaii)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:hawaiian
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_christian_missionaries
				add_ideology = ideology_eco_modernizer
			}
		}
		# Anglicans
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:maori
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:australian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:anglo_canadian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:irish
					c:NRU ?= this
				}
				NOT = {
					c:BIC ?= this
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_anglican_church
			}
		}
		# Russian Orthodox Church
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:orthodox
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:byelorussian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:ukrainian
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_orthodox_church
				bpm_ig_make_russian_patriarch = yes
			}
		}
		# Church of Denmark
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:danish
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_church_of_denmark
			}
		}
		# Church of Norway
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:norwegian
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_church_of_norway
			}
		}
		# Church of Sweden
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:swedish
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_church_of_sweden
			}
		}
		# Confucian Scholars
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:confucian
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_confucian
				bpm_ig_make_confucian = yes
			}
		}
		# Evangelicals
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:afro_american
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:cherokee
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_evangelicals
			}
		}
		# Roman Curia
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				c:PAP ?= this
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_roman_curia
				bpm_ig_make_papal_paternalistic = yes
			}
		}


		### Generic

		# Catholic Church
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic }
			ig:ig_devout = { 
				set_interest_group_name = ig_catholic_church 
			}
		}
		# Evangelical Church
		else_if = {
			limit = { 
				country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant 
				NOT = {
					c:BIC ?= this
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout = { 
				set_interest_group_name = ig_evangelical_church
			}
		}
		# Sunni Ulema
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:sunni }
			ig:ig_devout = { 
				set_interest_group_name = ig_sunni_madrasahs
			}
		}
		# Shi'a Ulema
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:shiite }
			ig:ig_devout = { 
				set_interest_group_name = ig_shia_madrasahs
			}
		}
		# Oriental Orthodox Church
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:oriental_orthodox }
			ig:ig_devout = { 
				set_interest_group_name = ig_oriental_orthodox_church
				bpm_ig_make_oriental_orthodox_patriarch = yes
			}
		}
		# Orthodox Church
		else_if = {
			limit = { 
				country_has_state_religion = rel:orthodox
				NOR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:byelorussian
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:ukrainian
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout = { 
				set_interest_group_name = ig_orthodox_church
				bpm_ig_make_orthodox_patriarch = yes
			}
		}
		# Hindu Priesthood
		else_if = {
			limit = { 
				OR = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:hindu
					c:BIC ?= this
				}
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_hindu_priesthood
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							c:BIC ?= this
						}
					}
					bpm_ig_make_hindu_moralist_british_india = yes
				}
				else = {
					bpm_ig_make_hindu_moralist = yes
				}
			}
		}
		# Vajrayana Monks
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:gelugpa }
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_vajrayana_monks
				bpm_ig_make_buddhist_moralist = yes
			}
		}
		# Vajrayana Monks
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:theravada }
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_theravada_monks
				bpm_ig_make_buddhist_moralist = yes
			}
		}
		# Mahayana Monks
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:mahayana }
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_mahayana_monks
				bpm_ig_make_buddhist_moralist = yes
			}
		}
		# Sikh Priesthood
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:sikh }
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_sikh_priesthood
				bpm_ig_make_sikh_moralist = yes
			}
		}

		ig:ig_devout = { bpm_reorder_ideologies = yes }
		if = {	# laws+
			limit = { country_has_state_religion = rel:animist }
			ig:ig_devout ?= { set_interest_group_name = ig_pagan_shamans }
		}
	}
	on_disable = {}

	priority_cultures = { #Country scope
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:BIC ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:british = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				assamese avadhi baluchi bengali bihari gujarati kannada malayalam marathi oriya panjabi pathan rajput sindi tamil telegu hindustani bundeli pahari gondi bageli chhattisgarhi deccani
			}
		}
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:ZAN ?= this
				any_primary_culture = {
					cu:bedouin = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				swahili
			}
		}
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:HAW ?= this
				NOT = { has_variable = deported_americans }
			}
			cultures = {
				yankee dixie british hawaiian
			}
		}
	}

	on_character_ig_membership = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
				}
			}
			change_character_religion = rel:hindu
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:ZAN ?= this
				}
			}
			change_character_religion = rel:sunni
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_total_separation
						has_law = law_type:law_state_atheism
					}
				}
			}
			change_character_religion = scope:interest_group.owner.religion
		}
		else = {
			change_character_religion = scope:interest_group.owner.country_definition.religion
		}
	}
		
	pop_potential = {
		OR = {
			has_state_religion = yes
			AND = {
				exists = c:BIC
				owner ?= c:BIC
				has_pop_religion = hindu
			}
			AND = {
				exists = c:ZAN
				owner ?= c:ZAN
				has_pop_religion = sunni
			}
		}
		NOT = { 
			has_pop_religion = atheist
		}
	}
	
	pop_weight = {
		value = 25

		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = peasants }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clergymen }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
				value = 500
			}
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion }
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "STATE_RELIGION_LAW"
				value = 2.0
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_total_separation }
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "TOTAL_SEPARATION_LAW"
				value = 0.8
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_state_atheism }
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "STATE_ATHEISM_LAW"
				value = 0.1
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "RELIGIOUS_INSTITUTIONS"
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						OR = {
							has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
							has_law = law_type:law_charitable_health_system
						}
					}
				}
				value = 50
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "DEVOUT_LITERACY"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					NOT = { 
						is_pop_type = clergymen
					}
				}
				value = literacy_rate
				multiply = -100
				add = 50
				max = 0
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "THEOCRACY"
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { has_law = law_type:law_theocracy }
					has_law = law_type:law_gwageo	# laws+
				}
				value = 100
			}
		}

		multiply = ig_attraction_to_interests_from_stability	
		
		multiply = {
			desc = "RELIGION_SUPPRESSED"
			value = 1.0
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen
					owner = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_total_separation
					}
				}
				value = 1.5
			}
		}		
		if = {	# laws+
			limit = {
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_gwageo }
				is_pop_type = bureaucrats
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_BUREAUCRATS"
				value = 100
			}
		}
	}
	
	monarch_weight = {
		owner.ig:ig_devout = {
			value = bpm_ig_monarch_weight
		}
	}	

	agitator_weight = {
		owner.ig:ig_devout = {
			value = bpm_base_agitator_weight
		}
	}
	
	commander_weight = {
		owner.ig:ig_devout = {
			value = bpm_commander_weight
		}
	}	

	executive_weight = {
		value = 0.1
	}
	
	noble_chance = {
		value = 0.5
	}
	
	female_commander_chance = {	
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_commander_spawn_chance
	}
	
	female_politician_chance = {
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_character_spawn_chance
	}	

	female_agitator_chance = {
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_character_spawn_chance		
	}

	female_executive_chance = {
		value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_character_spawn_chance
	}
	
	# The chance that a commander belonging to this IG takes over leadership when it changes
	# scope:character is the most popular commander in the IG
	commander_leader_chance = {
		value = 0.25
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:character
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1
				add = scope:character.popularity
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}
}
